entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with SPL G.R. Case No.11 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Sonepur, arising out of Lachhipur P.S. Case No.28 of 2023 for commission of offence alleged under Sections-363/366/376(3) of the IPC &
Sections-6 & 7 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Children's Court, Sonepur, by order dated 30.10.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. A report has been received from the learned Addl. Sess. Judge-cum-Special Judge, Sonepur dated 09.01.2024 indicating that the intimation has been given to the victim/informant regarding the matter, which is to be taken up today.
6. There is no appearance for the victim/informant, when the matter is called.

7. Learned counsel for the Petitioner places on record the photostat copy of the 164 Cr.P.C.
statement of the victim.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 11.05.2023 and as final form has already been submitted on 05.07.2023, he may be released on bail.
9. The copy of the final form as well as the photostat copy of the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim are taken on record.
10. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

11. Considering the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim & recitals in the case diary, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

12. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every month on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
13. Accordingly, the bail application stands disposed of.
14. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
